metadata.title: On the topology of some linear systems of hyperelliptic curves in Hirzebruch surfaces
metadata.abstract: Following a program suggested by Dolgachev and Libgober in 1981, we study the topology of the locus of smooth sections of linear systems of hyperelliptic curves on Hirzebruch surfaces. Our primary interest is the computation of various flavors of ``enriched monodromy representations''. Within this class of examples, we find that a variety of behaviors occur - in some situations the enriched monodromy faithfully captures the fundamental group, and in others it does not. Our arguments mainly leverage algebro-geometric techniques to compute cohomological obstructions to families of embeddings.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Hirzebruch 曲面超椭圆线性系的富化 monodromy
analysis.workSummary: 沿 Dolgachev–Libgober 方案，研究 Hirzebruch 曲面上若干超椭圆曲线线性系的光滑截面参数空间，计算不同富化 monodromy 表示。所得实例中，有的富化表示忠实记录参数空间基本群，有的存在非平凡核。
analysis.breakthrough: 通过嵌入族的上同调障碍识别同类线性系中富化 monodromy 的不同忠实性行为。
analysis.limitations: 结论针对文中选定线性系与富化表示。摘要未列忠实与非忠实各自适用的参数范围。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
